source.test: A. prog/gzclp-t1@2: every literal the evaluator read shows its number in the description

ret: 4 training days (A1, B1, A2 and B2) holding 4 exercises, over block weeks train, repeating.
Block weeks: train, repeating. If you miss a session the plan waits: the next session is still the one you missed. Loads on a 2.5 kg grid.
Rotation: Alternate Day A1 / Day B1 / Day A2 / Day B2, 3 sessions per training week.
Attendance (from the rotation): Train at least 3 times in each 7-day window (from your start day). If you don't train for 21 days, attendance stops counting until your next session.

squat: GZCLP T1 on Barbell Back Squat: 5×3+, then 6×2+, then 10×1+ on failure, adding 5 kg on success, counting total reps across all sets; after failing 10×1, test a 5RM and restart 5×3+ at 85% of it; starts at the squatLoad handed on by prog/linear-3x5 when a previous program hands one on.

bench: GZCLP T1 on Barbell Bench Press: 5×3+, then 6×2+, then 10×1+ on failure, adding 2.5 kg on success, counting total reps across all sets; after failing 10×1, test a 5RM and restart 5×3+ at 85% of it; starts at nothing when a previous program hands one on.

dead: GZCLP T1 on Deadlift: 5×3+, then 6×2+, then 10×1+ on failure, adding 5 kg on success, counting total reps across all sets; after failing 10×1, test a 5RM and restart 5×3+ at 85% of it; starts at nothing when a previous program hands one on.

press: GZCLP T1 on Overhead Press: 5×3+, then 6×2+, then 10×1+ on failure, adding 2.5 kg on success, counting total reps across all sets; after failing 10×1, test a 5RM and restart 5×3+ at 85% of it; starts at nothing when a previous program hands one on.
Starts squatStart from the previous run of prog/linear-3x5's squatLoad, if there was one.

ret: GZCLP T1 on Barbell Back Squat: 5×3+, then 6×2+, then 10×1+ on failure, adding 5 kg on success, counting total reps across all sets; after failing 10×1, test a 5RM and restart 5×3+ at 85% of it; starts at the squatLoad handed on by prog/linear-3x5 when a previous program hands one on
Reads your estimated max (kept on file; ignored once older than 56 days).
Starts with stage = “5x3”; written by session, owner.

Starts with working weight = whichever is known first: (1) the squatLoad handed on by prog/linear-3x5; (2) 85% of the load you could lift for 5 reps with 0 in reserve, given an estimated max of your estimated max for Barbell Back Squat; written by session, owner.

Plan:
    - if your stage is “5x3”: Barbell Back Squat: 4 sets of 3 reps at your working weight; 1 set of as many reps as possible (at least 3 reps) at your working weight.
    - if your stage is “6x2”: Barbell Back Squat: 5 sets of 2 reps at your working weight; 1 set of as many reps as possible (at least 2 reps) at your working weight.
    - if your stage is “10x1”: Barbell Back Squat: 9 sets of 1 rep at your working weight; 1 set of as many reps as possible (at least 1 rep) at your working weight.
    - if your stage is “retest”: Barbell Back Squat: 1 set of test 5 reps with 0 in reserve.

After each session:
    - if your stage is “5x3”:
      - if the working sets totalled their target reps (and every other bound was met): Set working weight to your working weight plus 5 kg.
      - if the total reps fell short with every set logged, or a set missed another bound: Set stage to “6x2”.
      - if nothing decided it: Something went unlogged: leave everything as is.
    - if your stage is “6x2”:
      - if the working sets totalled their target reps (and every other bound was met): Set working weight to your working weight plus 5 kg.
      - if the total reps fell short with every set logged, or a set missed another bound: Set stage to “10x1”.
      - if nothing decided it: Something went unlogged: leave everything as is.
    - if your stage is “10x1”:
      - if the working sets totalled their target reps (and every other bound was met): Set working weight to your working weight plus 5 kg.
      - if the total reps fell short with every set logged, or a set missed another bound: Set stage to “retest”.
      - if nothing decided it: Something went unlogged: leave everything as is.
    - if your stage is “retest”:
      - if the best load you logged on “test” is unknown: Leave everything as is.
      - otherwise: Set stage to “5x3”; set working weight to 85% of the best load you logged on “test”.
